title: Supportive co-pollutant mutual-adjustment sensitivity analysis
estimand: Adjusted repeated-measure association per buffer-specific IQR
outcome: BAA_PhenoAge supplied in the cleaned analytical dataset
model: Unweighted WeMix random-intercept model with robust covariance and the primary covariate set
limitations: PM2.5 and NO2 are current-year fields in this sensitivity analysis; they are not treated as validated four-year means.
Models use complete cases, reducing the frame relative to the primary model.
This analysis is supportive and does not establish a causal or independent ozone effect.
